name: equal_value
body:
for (struct ListNode *p = headA; p; p = p->next) { for (struct ListNode *q = headB; q; q = q->next) { if (p->val == q->val) { return p; } } }
return NULL;

name: later_shared
body: struct ListNode *p = headA, *q = headB; while (p != q) { p = p ? p->next : headB; q = q ? q->next : headA; } return p ? p->next : NULL;

name: link_mutation
body: struct ListNode *p = headA, *q = headB; while (p != q) { p = p ? p->next : headB; q = q ? q->next : headA; } if (headA) { headA->next = headA; } return p;

name: value_mutation
body: struct ListNode *p = headA, *q = headB; while (p != q) { p = p ? p->next : headB; q = q ? q->next : headA; } if (headA) { headA->val += 1; } return p;
